title: Detainees Released in Bnei Brak
body: Thousands in Bnei Brak and Modi'in Illit celebrate release of yeshiva students with large processions, dancing and singing.

title: Hostage Thanks Vizhnitzer Rebbe
body: Yosef Chaim Ochana, freed from Hamas captivity, thanks Vizhnitzer Rebbe for support at Chanukah candle lighting in Bnei Brak.

title: Chida's 250-Year-Old Check
body: Rav Chaim Yosef Dovid Azulai, the Chida, signed a 250-year-old bill of exchange, a precursor to a modern-day check, for a substantial sum.
